description: A pricing migration with sound arithmetic and no plan for the humans affected.

flaws.description: Every existing account is switched at once with no grandfathering, opt-in period, or migration on renewal.
The revenue model extrapolates from 30 accounts in a single month, with no check that the sample or the month is representative.
The model reports aggregate revenue but never counts how many individual accounts would pay more, or how much more.
Relies on the 14-day contractual minimum for a change of billing model, which is legally sufficient and commercially hostile.
No stated way to reverse the change if churn spikes after week 4.
Unpredictable invoices generate recurring support contacts; nobody has costed the support impact.
